AI Hub - Windows
================

1. Unzip this folder somewhere you like (right-click the .zip -> "Extract All"),
   for example into Documents. Do not run it from inside the .zip.

2. The first time, double-click  bootstrap.cmd
   It checks Node.js (version 18 or newer), offers to install what is missing
   with winget (it always asks first), then runs the guided setup.
   If it installed something, close the window and run bootstrap.cmd once more.

3. From then on, double-click  start.cmd
   The interface opens in your browser. Close the black window to stop it.
   Tip: "npm run shortcut" (in a terminal inside this folder) puts a shortcut on your desktop.

Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": the scripts are plain text
and not code-signed. Click "More info" -> "Run anyway" if you trust this download.

Minimum: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), Node.js 18+ (installed for you if missing),
about 200 MB of free disk space, a modern web browser.
Optional: Git (installing skills from GitHub), one AI tool (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI or OpenCode).

Docs: GUIDE.md.
